explanation:
PHASE A — CRITERIA ONLY. No implementation verdict or source/comparison/delivery SHIP is issued. The permitted scope and review references define the frozen acceptance matrix below; repository implementation, diffs, gates and prior review artifacts were not opened in this call. Independence limitation: carried-forward context exposed candidate-specific outcomes before this call. Those outcomes were excluded from this matrix, but strict outcome blindness cannot be certified; a fresh reviewer context supplied only the scope and review references is the exact prerequisite for an uncontaminated blind assessment.

COMMON DISPOSITION RULES
For every criterion below, SHIP requires attributable evidence satisfying the stated contract for the exact candidate. FIX-FIRST requires a demonstrated defect, violated acceptance criterion, failed required validation or unauthorized scope change, with a discrete correction. BLOCKED means the necessary artifact identity, evidence, sanctioned access, environment or owner decision is unavailable; absence of evidence is not itself proof of a code defect. A worker assertion, filename or previous verdict is not exercised proof. No criterion may be silently waived, and changes invalidate affected review/gate coverage.

FROZEN MATRIX
Q01 — Candidate and evidence identity, G9. Require the exact commit or one documented sorted bytes-and-mode manifest covering tracked, untracked and generated candidate artifacts, explicit exclusions, algorithm, count and digest. Bind every gate, smoke, experiment and review to its actual input identity and reconcile any changes after validation. SHIP: identities and continuity agree. FIX-FIRST: demonstrated mismatched or altered artifacts are represented as current evidence. BLOCKED: identity or continuity cannot be established.
Q02 — Protected originals and operator state, G1/G2/G6/G9. Require before/after original Mikro HEAD, index, relevant tracked/untracked WIP hashes, original Genie work and operator configuration/credential/helper inventories, sanitized without revealing secrets. SHIP: protected state is unchanged except explicitly authorized additive project provisioning. FIX-FIRST: proven unauthorized mutation. BLOCKED: preservation evidence is missing or cannot be compared.
Q03 — Non-squash history and authority boundary, G1. Require the imported source commit 62894e49314bad07382492ac074ea96df6776f61 to remain an ancestor; two-parent import and initial subtree/source tree equality; root discovery and legacy catalog behavior proving foreign ancestry/skills do not acquire Genie retirement authority. SHIP: history, tree and ownership boundaries hold. FIX-FIRST: a proven graph/tree/authority violation. BLOCKED: complete graph or original inventory is unavailable.
Q04 — Independent packages and full gates, G1/G9. Require exact Mikro npm/lock/Node authority, separate type environment, independent CI and complete dependency/build/check/test gates; Genie frozen Bun installation and complete existing root gate under the host lock. Record commands, versions, environment, exits, counts/skips and duration. SHIP: required full gates pass on the candidate, with only documented inherited environment corrections. FIX-FIRST: an attributable required gate fails or coverage was suppressed. BLOCKED: current attributable full-gate proof is absent; a focused suite cannot replace it.
Q05 — Exact SDK and truthful completion boundary, G2. Require package/lock/runtime identity for the directly used Pi 1.0.2 family, supported package-local APIs, built-in Flash resolution, preserved custom providers/auth/sampling controls, default retries and explicit zero. Trace error/abort/length and usage through callers. SHIP: actual provider/compiled scenarios and owning regressions prove failure classification and usage once. FIX-FIRST: false success, discarded/doubled usage, ineffective retry control or provider regression. BLOCKED: actual boundary proof or dependency identity is missing.
Q06 — Safe FINAL interpretation, G3. Require bare safe identifiers, quoted literals, missing variables and ellipsis scenarios through the real parser/REPL consumer. SHIP: identifiers resolve without arbitrary expression evaluation and invalid finals produce repair feedback rather than accepted answers. FIX-FIRST: expression execution, incorrect literal/identifier handling or invalid-final acceptance. BLOCKED: runtime evidence cannot be attributed.
Q07 — Timeout lifecycle and non-replay, G3. Require real Python/bridge evidence with an observable side effect, timed-out child termination/wait/detachment, fresh context/tools, explicit lost variables, stale-reply isolation and terminal restart/deadline failure. SHIP: timed-out code executes once and the replacement cannot be corrupted. FIX-FIRST: replay, stale-child interference, hidden state loss or terminal failure masked as recovery. BLOCKED: lifecycle proof is absent.
Q08 — Budgeted finalization and failure accounting, G2/G3/G4. Require model-call, validation, token/cost and deadline traces for last-turn schema finalization, provider failure, cancellation and known/unknown usage. SHIP: no extra completion beyond the declared cap; reported usage survives once; unknown remains unknown; invalid/cancelled output is not successful. FIX-FIRST: cap overrun, false success, fabricated complete totals or discarded/doubled reported usage. BLOCKED: actual traces or outward consumer receipts are missing.
Q09 — Public selector and dispatch closure, G4/G5. Require default rlm, strict call > agent > default precedence, generic-query behavior, all four engine values, rejection of obsolete backend keys and invalid engine types before billing. Trace every produced value through consuming dispatch and every active caller. SHIP: compiled MCP and Genie caller prove explicit routing with no hidden heuristic/fallback or silent drop. FIX-FIRST: missing dispatch, stale caller, wrong precedence or post-billing rejection. BLOCKED: compiled caller/consumer proof is absent.
Q10 — Scoped Pi security boundary, G4. Require isolated SDK resources/settings/sessions, only read/grep/glob/git/emit_done, realpath containment and hermetic read-only git; adversarial out-of-root, symlink, mutation, external diff/textconv/fsmonitor/pager/hooks, config-environment and ambient-resource denial. SHIP: real SDK exercises establish containment without operator-state mutation. FIX-FIRST: a reachable escape or unauthorized execution/resource load. BLOCKED: a material boundary lacks attributable evidence.
Q11 — Pi final tool and existing result contracts, G4. Require schema precedence and both validations, first accepted final, stop-after-turn, meaningful missing/invalid final errors, actual usage/limits/progress and abort/dispose cleanup. Trace MCP structuredContent {answer, session_id}, priced footer, history and failure classification into Genie consumers for success and failure. SHIP: actual compiled SDK/MCP/caller scenarios preserve these contracts without REPL or paragraph fallback. FIX-FIRST: accepted invalid final, leaked work after stop/abort, broken envelope/accounting or silent event drop. BLOCKED: end-to-end consumer proof is missing.
Q12 — Proposal-only NEW and citation separation, G5. Require top-level plan.files declarations, missing paths without line citations, tracked nearest ancestor, containment and rejection of untracked/ignored existing paths, traversal and symlinks. SHIP: owning behavior tests and actual scoring show a NEW declaration cannot validate ordinary evidence for the same absent path or inherit stale success. FIX-FIRST: proposal/citation authority conflation or false verification. BLOCKED: independent oracle/provenance evidence is missing.
Q13 — Frozen parent-tree fixtures, G5/G8. Require all four original frozen fixture identities, source/parent/evaluation commits, implementation absence at execution, faithful runtime overlay provenance, and separate NEW/file/citation scoring. SHIP: actual generator/launcher behavior proves no answer leakage and no fixture mutation. FIX-FIRST: implementation leakage, wrong tree, unsafe overlay or falsified provenance. BLOCKED: original freeze or runtime-tree evidence is unavailable.
Q14 — Caller and genuine wish treatments, G5/G8. Require strict call/bench engine forwarding and effective-treatment metadata, saved wish.js offloadEngine normalization, selected engine on both scout/review offloads, off skipping both while preserving native stages, and omitted controls preserving current RLM behavior. Require repository generic query without model override to resolve and successfully call built-in deepseek/deepseek-flash; obsolete repository Pro/provider defaults must not shadow it, while operator settings remain untouched. SHIP: actual caller/workflow/configuration behavior proves each treatment. FIX-FIRST: decorative treatment tags, changed native models, unskipped offloads or incorrect defaults. BLOCKED: actual saved-workflow/compiled query proof is absent.
Q15 — Juice provisioning, credential isolation and catalog, G6. Require explicit origin/project/key reference, distinct private Genie/brain project keys, directory 0700/file 0600, supported additive/idempotent provisioning, actual authenticated catalog and project inference, advertised IDs and invocation-scoped credentials. SHIP: authorized integration works without unrelated key/global-provider mutation or secret disclosure. FIX-FIRST: credential leak, global mutation, invented identity or destructive provisioning. BLOCKED: sanctioned access/provisioning proof is unavailable; never escalate authorization.
Q16 — Viewer-scoped Keeper aggregates, G6. Require actual project-key viewer login, in-memory session, overview/analysis/latency snapshots and URL/query/project/key epoch/range/timezone/fetch-time/hash provenance, with secret-safe failure paths. SHIP: responses are project-scoped and unavailable costs/fields remain unknown, never canonical runtime billing. FIX-FIRST: cross-project exposure, request/admin export, fabricated fields or duplicate accounting. BLOCKED: viewer access or required actual snapshots are unavailable.
Q17 — Manual typed JEV only, G7. Require an explicit sanctioned endpoint/model/key, exactly one cancellable official {state,model,questions} request, bounded source-linked candidate IDs, Choice/abstention and caller-requested optional questions in that same request, validated model/typed probabilities/usage and preserved source span. Prove ordinary model/MCP runs make no JEV or extra instrumentation calls. SHIP: actual configured manual extraction plus owning behavior evidence satisfies the boundary. FIX-FIRST: automatic/retried extraction, false success, bad source mapping, unsupported response acceptance or extra ordinary-run calls. BLOCKED: exact sanctioned endpoint/auth prerequisite remains unreachable after available discovery; no substitute endpoint or admin escalation.
Q18 — Frozen matched model experiments, G8. Require four original fixtures, 36 Flash control runs, all separately frozen available curated candidate cells, three reps and concurrency 1; freeze runtime/launcher/artifact/schema/prompt/pricing identities and catalog exclusions before outcomes. Retain every attempt/failure/retry/unknown and actual model identity; no Pro/Claude calls or scored/re-pinned Prime arm. SHIP: complete matched coverage and provenance. FIX-FIRST: resampling, omitted attempts, changed cells, forbidden models or manipulated treatment. BLOCKED: any required cell/provenance remains unavailable; completed subsets are not the complete experiment.
Q19 — Metrics and recommendation threshold, G8. Require all-attempt and run latency p50/p90, repetition dispersion, file/NEW/citation metrics, cap share, actual costs, coverage and cost per verified success. SHIP for a recommendation additionally requires cell-wise verified-success parity and real-workflow non-regression; source SHIP alone implies no performance winner. FIX-FIRST: speed-only selection, fabricated zero/complete costs, denominator manipulation or a recommendation below parity. BLOCKED: missing/unknown accounting prevents a valid completed comparison, even when outcomes exist.
Q20 — Eighteen real wish runs and single-count accounting, G8. Require two bounded objectives × three treatments × three reps in independent roots using the real saved workflow, demonstrated non-Claude native route/observer, actual workflow UUID/seq/childId, persisted own-suffix assistant/message and assistant/attempt usage, once-only tool/offload events and lifecycle durations, SHIP/repair/outcome records. SHIP: all 18 genuine runs and fully measured compatible report records, with no inherited/forked/aggregate-spend double billing. FIX-FIRST: synthetic IDs, surrogate workflow, invented totals, incompatible append or double billing. BLOCKED: required runs or measured top-level accounting are incomplete; genuine execution alone does not close comparison.
Q21 — Installed/compiled/release and maintainability quality, G1–G9. Require actual relevant CLI/MCP and standalone install/update contracts in disposable environments; nested standalone-update refusal before mutations; all existing Genie release targets/payload checks with original contract retained and no Mikro runtime dependency/bundling. Require affected docs/changelogs, complete selector cutover, no permanent smoke scaffolds/fake fallback, and scoped independent security/maintainability/performance review. SHIP: shipped artifacts and owning regressions prove behavior and no blocking quality gap remains. FIX-FIRST: installed/release regression, boundary mutation, obsolete active API, prohibited extra machinery or failed mandatory surface. BLOCKED: mandatory installed/compiled/release proof or independent review is absent; unexecuted platforms must be stated, not implied tested.
Q22 — Final remote delivery and bounded repairs, G9. Require exact-path final scope, current candidate full gates, separate independent implementation and quality SHIP, original preservation proof, and actual PR head/live dev base/files/current-head CI readback establishing merge-ready delivery. Keep main, production installs and source deletion untouched. Freeze the supplied repair limits B=2 and quality cap=1 unless a separately evidenced owner authorization changes them; retain attempts and invalidate affected verdicts after repairs. SHIP: all these agree on the final candidate and complete scope. FIX-FIRST: unauthorized repair/scope expansion, failed current required check or delivered mismatch. BLOCKED: current remote/preservation/review evidence is missing or an exact unresolved prerequisite prevents delivery.

G8/G9 RECONCILIATION AND VERDICT LEVELS
G9's exercised-proof-or-exact-unreachable-prerequisite clause permits honest disposition of an external blocker; it does not waive a criterion, convert unknown accounting to measured accounting, authorize fabricated records, or overrule G8's explicit missing-accounting blocker. An exact unreachable prerequisite must name the missing sanctioned capability/input, the boundary it blocks, available discovery attempts and what reachable work was completed. A declared prerequisite can satisfy the obligation to explain non-execution, while the underlying comparison or delivery remains BLOCKED. A demonstrated source defect is FIX-FIRST rather than excused by an external prerequisite.
Source/feature SHIP: Q01–Q17 and relevant Q21/Q22 local source/review/gate requirements pass, with any unavailable external operational proof explicitly separated; an unproved named feature is not silently included in SHIP. This verdict makes no experiment, efficiency, full-wish or remote-delivery claim.
Comparison SHIP: Q18–Q20 pass completely, including measured accounting and any recommendation's parity/non-regression conditions. Missing accounting is always BLOCKED for completed comparison.
Whole-delivery SHIP: all Q01–Q22 pass and final remote evidence agrees with the candidate. A source-only authorization may permit a separately labeled publication, but cannot rename it complete G1–G9 delivery. The wish remains IN_PROGRESS until authorized merge and required QA; neither review nor green CI authorizes merge/main promotion.

PHASE B HANDOFF
Provide this frozen matrix unchanged, a strictly independent reviewer context if blind independence is required, the exact sorted candidate identity and exclusions, full patch/context and consumer dispatch, original-state comparisons, attributable complete gates and actual-surface receipts, original frozen experiment identities/all attempts/accounting, and final remote readback. No new inference, JEV call, resampling, repair, dependency change, schema change or verification execution is authorized by this review. There are no code findings in Phase A because no implementation was inspected.
